title: Qatari PM heads to Iran to 'de-escalate tensions' as tanker attack tests Trump’s Hormuz claim
summary_full: The Prime Minister of U.S.-ally Qatar is in Iran for talks on Thursday as part of efforts to "de-escalate tensions" between Tehran and Washington.
